title: Bach House (Eisenach)
geometryLabel: Historic Frauenplan 21 house; modern western museum extension and neighboring eastern buildings excluded.
identityStatus: Reviewed against individually inspected Qualla front/rear photographs, official museum history and aerial roof context.

orientationControl.basis: Long ridge follows east-west frontage; street facade faces north, garden faces south. Modern museum extension lies west.

terrainContact.basis: Front approach below the historic door steps; terrain datum is independent of the building geometry.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap; local Qualla originals; official Bachhaus history and aerial roof context.
notes: Mapped historic footprint is approximately 20.3 by 9.4 m. Map height 8 m is not a surveyed roof/eave measurement. Roof pitch, two storeys, small rear projection and hidden ends are photographic estimates.
limitations: The timber frame is plastered in the surviving exterior; no invented exposed half-timber grid.
Independent terrain retained; footprint replacement disabled.
